# Diagram Drawing Skill for Muse

Describe a system, process, or idea in plain language and Muse produces a professional dark-themed SVG diagram — architecture, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER and class diagrams, mind maps, timelines, state machines, data flows — as a single self-contained .svg file with embedded styles. Honest caveat: exporting PNG needs bun and the repo's conversion script; the SVG itself needs nothing at all. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
